plans.idea: Product-first strip read left to right: the bottle anchors the left end, the logo sits above a wide text block in the middle, and the 'Taste the Glow' pill closes the row on the right as the action.

Keeps the original's text-left, bottle-right arrangement, stretched into three bands: copy fills the left half, the bottle sits in the middle, and the logo stacks above the CTA pill in a right-hand column, so the row ends on brand plus action.
Classic leaderboard order: the logo signs in at the far left, the headline and copy come next, then the bottle, with the CTA pill at the far-right end, all vertically centered on one shared midline.
